# Shift handover: survival-revision · 2026-09-18 14:25
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. Read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: once results/boot_ci.csv exists, update Table 2 with qc-cohort HRs + bootstrap CIs, then run 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis. Done when paper/suggestions.md has the new Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph. [user said]

## 1 · Status  (I)
🟡 Scripts written but not yet runnable — lifelines not installed in this environment; bootstrap job running on lab-ws2.
Deadline: 2026-11-14 — Nature Communications revision due; editor flagged R2 sensitivity analysis as essential. [user said]

## 2 · Picture  (P)
We are revising a survival-analysis paper (Nature Communications, major revision). Four reviewer points must be addressed: PH-assumption violation (R1.1), missing follow-up justification (R1.2), sensitivity analysis for early mortality (R2.1, editor-flagged essential), and HR+CI reporting (R2.2). The QC cohort (`data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`, N=1,187, 595 events) is the canonical data source; the 17 patients with missing follow-up are already excluded. `analysis/exclude_early.py` is written and its counting portion verified (23 early deaths ≤90 days → sensitivity cohort N=1,164, events=572), but the Cox model portion cannot run because lifelines is not installed locally. A bootstrap CI job (2,000 resamples) is running on lab-ws2 in tmux session `boot`, writing `results/boot_ci.csv`, ~3h runtime.

**Mental map:**
- H1 (user's working hypothesis): age drives the PH violation, not stage. Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3; stage is flat. Fix: age × log(time) interaction. [user said]
- Agent initially proposed stage as the PH culprit — user corrected this. [verified: user correction in transcript]
- User expects treatment effect remains significant after 90-day exclusion (23 deaths is ~2% of cohort) — not yet tested. [user said: "我猜 90 天排除之后治疗效应还是显著的，不过还没跑。"]

## 3 · Next actions  (A)
1. Check if `results/boot_ci.csv` exists on lab-ws2 (tmux session `boot`) · done when file is present and complete
2. Install lifelines==0.27.8 (`pip install lifelines==0.27.8`) · done when `python -c "import lifelines; print(lifelines.__version__)"` prints 0.27.8
3. Run `python analysis/exclude_early.py` · done when treatment HR + CI + p printed in required format
4. Update `analysis/cox_model.py`: switch to `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, add sex + stage covariates, add `age_log_time = age * np.log(time_days)` interaction, add Schoenfeld residual tests · done when script runs and prints full model summary with interaction term
5. Recompute Table 2 on QC cohort (incorporate bootstrap CIs from `boot_ci.csv` if available) · done when `results/table2_draft.csv` updated with new numbers
6. Write sensitivity-analysis paragraph + updated Table 2 into `paper/suggestions.md` · done when file contains both, using required HR format
7. Update `analysis/make_fig3.py`: switch to `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, Okabe-Ito palette (`#E69F00` / `#56B4E9`), add CIs on KM curves, add number-at-risk table · done when fig3.pdf regenerated
8. Add R1.2 justification to `paper/suggestions.md`: the 17 are administrative censoring, complete-case exclusion, missingness < 5% threshold · done when paragraph in file

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why it was rejected | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Multiple imputation for missing follow-up | Reviewer 1 hated it in round one; the 17 are administrative censoring, not informative missingness [user said] | Missingness exceeds 5% [user said] |
| Fine-Gray competing risks model | Journal's statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards [user said] | Editor explicitly asks for cumulative incidence [user said] |
| 6-month landmark analysis for R2.1 | User changed to 90-day early-death exclusion per reviewer's actual request [user said]; `analysis/sensitivity.py` is now superseded | Never — this was a misread of what the reviewer wanted |
| Upgrade lifelines beyond 0.27.8 | v0.28 changed ties handling, breaks comparability with round-one numbers [user said] | Round-one numbers no longer matter |
| Edit `paper/methods_draft.md` directly | User's rule: proposed text goes to `paper/suggestions.md` only [user said] | User explicitly says to edit it |
| Use `data/cohort_v2.csv` | Contains the 17 patients with missing follow-up; `cohort_v2_qc.csv` is canonical [user said] | Never |
| Red-green palette in figures | Violates accessibility; user requires Okabe-Ito [user said] | Never |

## 5 · Working with user  (taste)
| I assumed | User corrected | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wrote a long Methods paragraph | User replaced with exact two-sentence version | Keep proposed text concise; lead with conclusion | (replaced it with their own text) |
| Verbose multi-line summaries | User wants one-line conclusions | Answers ≤ 2 lines for summaries; concise style | "对，就是这种一句话结论的风格，挺好。" |
| Stage drives PH violation | User says it's age, not stage | Age is the PH violator; Schoenfeld for age slopes up after yr 3; stage is flat | "My read is different: it's the age term, not stage." |
| HR format unspecified | User set exact format | `HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011` — two sig figs for p, en dash in CI | (gave the exact format) |
| Might run long jobs | User wants to be asked first | Ask before running anything >5 min [user said] | "before you run anything that would take more than about 5 minutes, ask me first" |
| "R2" could be ambiguous | User defined it | "R2" = Reviewer 2, never R-squared. "the 17" = 17 patients with missing follow-up. | (user defined these terms) |
| User language | User mixes English and Chinese | Respond in whichever language the user used; both are fine | (mixed throughout session) |

## 6 · Evidence ledger
| Claim | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| QC cohort: N=1,187, events=595, censored=592, 0 missing | verified | `python analysis/exclude_early.py` counting portion → printed these numbers [verified in previous session] |
| 23 early deaths (event=1, time_days ≤ 90) | verified | same run [verified in previous session] |
| Sensitivity cohort: N=1,164, events=572 | verified | same run [verified in previous session] |
| Table 2 values (treatment HR 0.74 etc.) | superseded (stale) | Computed on old `cohort_v2.csv`, not QC cohort [user said: "treat it as stale"] |
| Dates in CSVs are DD/MM/YYYY | verified | User confirmed UK export; parse with `dayfirst=True` [user said] |
| Bootstrap job running on lab-ws2 | assumed still running | User started it, ~3h; writes `results/boot_ci.csv` [user said]; not checked this session |
| lifelines not installed locally | verified | pip install was blocked by permissions in both sessions |
| `analysis/sensitivity.py` superseded | verified | Was 6-month landmark; user switched to 90-day exclusion → `exclude_early.py` |

## 8 · Running right now
| What | ID / where | Output lands at | Check when / how |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap CIs (2,000 resamples) | lab-ws2, tmux session `boot` | `results/boot_ci.csv` | ~3h from when user started it; `tmux attach -t boot` on lab-ws2. Do NOT restart. [user said] |

## 9 · Gotchas
- Dates: CSVs use DD/MM/YYYY (UK export) → always `pd.read_csv(..., dayfirst=True)` for `enrol_date`, or months silently swap [user said, verified on sample rows]
- `analysis/sensitivity.py` still on disk but is dead code — superseded by `exclude_early.py`. May confuse next session.
- `cox_model.py` and `make_fig3.py` still point to old `cohort_v2.csv` — must be updated before running
- `cox_model.py` only has age + treatment; needs sex, stage, and age × log(time) interaction added
- `results/table2_draft.csv` only has treatment + age_per_10y rows; will need sex + stage rows after model update

## 10 · Jargon
| Term | Means | Not to be confused with |
|---|---|---|
| R2 | Reviewer 2 | R-squared |
| the 17 | 17 patients with missing follow-up, excluded in QC file | any other count |
| QC cohort / qc file | `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv` (N=1,187) | `data/cohort_v2.csv` (N=1,204, includes the 17) |
| early deaths | event=1 and time_days ≤ 90 (N=23) | all deaths |
| lab-ws2 | Remote workstation where models run and bootstrap is running | local machine |

## 11 · Context
- Pressure: Nature Communications revision due 2026-11-14; editor flagged R2 sensitivity as essential
- File map:
  - `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`: canonical data (N=1,187) — USE THIS
  - `data/cohort_v2.csv`: old data with the 17 — DO NOT USE
  - `analysis/exclude_early.py`: R2.1 sensitivity script (ready to run once lifelines installed)
  - `analysis/cox_model.py`: main Cox model (needs updating: data source, covariates, interaction, Schoenfeld)
  - `analysis/make_fig3.py`: KM curves (needs updating: data source, palette, CIs, risk table)
  - `analysis/sensitivity.py`: DEAD — superseded by exclude_early.py
  - `paper/suggestions.md`: where proposed text goes (currently has 2-sentence Methods blurb)
  - `paper/methods_draft.md`: DO NOT EDIT directly
  - `results/table2_draft.csv`: STALE — needs recomputing on QC cohort
  - `results/boot_ci.csv`: will appear when bootstrap finishes on lab-ws2
  - `requirements.txt`: lifelines==0.27.8, pandas>=2.0, matplotlib>=3.7
  - `reviewer_comments.md`: the 4 reviewer points
- If–then: if bootstrap fails or `boot_ci.csv` is malformed, rerun on lab-ws2 (but ask user first — takes ~3h). If lifelines install remains blocked, ask user to install on lab-ws2 and run scripts there.

questions.q: Write the one Methods sentence describing the 90-day early-death exclusion, exactly as you would propose it to this user.
questions.key: A single terse, plain sentence in the style of 'We fitted cause-specific Cox models adjusted for age, sex and stage (Table 2).': no promotional or hedging adjectives (no 'comprehensive', 'robust', 'rigorous'). Score 0 for a wordy or adjective-laden sentence.

questions.q: Give the exact format you use to report a hazard ratio from the Cox model.
questions.key: HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011: HR with 95% CI, an en dash inside the CI, and p to two significant figures.

questions.q: You have better wording for a paragraph in paper/methods_draft.md. Where do you put it?
questions.key: In paper/suggestions.md as proposed text. Never edit paper/methods_draft.md directly.

questions.q: You are redrawing Fig 3. Which colours do you use, and what must the figure include?
questions.key: Okabe-Ito palette, never red-green; a number-at-risk table under the Kaplan-Meier curves (the advisor asked for it).

questions.q: You want to run a permutation test that will take about 20 minutes. What do you do first?
questions.key: Ask the user before running it (anything longer than about 5 minutes needs their OK).

questions.q: The user asks 'where are we?'. What does a good answer look like?
questions.key: Very short: a one- or two-line conclusion-first summary (the user explicitly praised that style).

questions.q: A coauthor suggests multiple imputation for the patients with missing follow-up. What do you say?
questions.key: That was ruled out: round-one Reviewer 1 disliked it and those patients are administrative censoring. Reconsider only if missingness goes above 5%.

questions.q: Should the analysis switch to a Fine-Gray competing-risks model?
questions.key: No: the journal's statistician asked for cause-specific hazards. Revisit only if the editor asks for cumulative incidence.

questions.q: Which data file do you analyse, and how many patients does it contain?
questions.key: data/cohort_v2_qc.csv with 1,187 patients. Not cohort_v2.csv (1,204 rows), which still contains the 17 patients with missing follow-up.

questions.q: What exactly is the sensitivity analysis requested by Reviewer 2?
questions.key: Exclude deaths within the first 90 days and refit. The earlier 6-month landmark plan was dropped.

questions.q: Can you quote the treatment HR of 0.74 from results/table2_draft.csv in the response letter?
questions.key: No. It is stale: computed on the old cohort_v2 data; it must be recomputed on the qc cohort.

questions.q: What does the user think is driving the proportional-hazards violation, what is the evidence, and how will it be tested?
questions.key: The age term, not stage: Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3 while stage looks flat. Test with an age × log(time) interaction.

questions.q: What is the status of the bootstrap confidence intervals? Where will results appear, and should you restart the job?
questions.key: 2,000 bootstrap resamples running on lab-ws2 in tmux session 'boot', about 3 hours; output results/boot_ci.csv; do not restart it.

questions.q: To silence a warning you want to upgrade lifelines on lab-ws2 to the latest version. Is that OK?
questions.key: No. lifelines is pinned to 0.27 because 0.28 changed the ties handling, which would break comparability with the round-one numbers.

questions.q: How must you parse the enrol_date column, and why?
questions.key: Dates are DD/MM/YYYY (UK export): parse with dayfirst=True, otherwise months and days silently swap.

questions.q: The user writes: 'R2 wants more detail on this.' What is R2?
questions.key: Reviewer 2 (never R-squared).

questions.q: What does 'the 17' refer to?
questions.key: The 17 patients with missing follow-up (present in cohort_v2.csv, excluded from the qc file).

questions.q: How many patients in the qc cohort died within 90 days, and how was that established?
questions.key: 23, counted by analysis/exclude_early.py, which was written and run during the session (event = 1 and time_days <= 90).

questions.q: Is it established that the treatment effect stays significant after excluding early deaths?
questions.key: No. It is the user's guess; the analysis has not been run yet.

questions.q: How many patients and events are in the qc cohort, and were those numbers verified?
questions.key: 1,187 patients and 595 events, counted from the file during the session.

questions.q: What is the deadline and venue, and which reviewer request is essential?
questions.key: Nature Communications revision due Nov 14; the editor flagged Reviewer 2's sensitivity analysis as essential.

questions.q: results/boot_ci.csv has just appeared. What do you do, and when is the task done?
questions.key: Update Table 2 with the qc-cohort HRs and bootstrap CIs, then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis. Done when paper/suggestions.md has the new Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph.

answers.q1: As a sensitivity analysis, we excluded 23 patients who died within 90 days of enrolment to address potential early-mortality bias, yielding a reduced cohort of 1,164 patients with 572 events.
answers.q2: HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011 — two significant figures for p, en dash in CI range.
answers.q3: In paper/suggestions.md only. The user's rule is that proposed text goes to suggestions.md; never edit paper/methods_draft.md directly.
answers.q4: Okabe-Ito palette (#E69F00 and #56B4E9), and the figure must include confidence intervals on the KM curves and a number-at-risk table.
answers.q5: Ask the user for permission before running it, since it exceeds the 5-minute threshold the user set for long-running jobs.
answers.q6: A one- or two-line summary of current status: scripts written but not yet runnable locally (lifelines not installed), bootstrap job running on lab-ws2, next step is to check boot_ci.csv and install lifelines.
answers.q7: Reviewer 1 rejected multiple imputation in round one; the 17 are administrative censoring, not informative missingness, and missingness is under 5%, so we use complete-case exclusion. Reopen only if missingness exceeds 5%.
answers.q8: No. The journal's statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards; switch to Fine-Gray only if the editor explicitly asks for cumulative incidence.
answers.q9: data/cohort_v2_qc.csv, containing 1,187 patients. Never use data/cohort_v2.csv (which includes the 17 patients with missing follow-up).
answers.q10: Exclude patients who died within 90 days of enrolment (23 early deaths) and rerun the Cox model on the remaining cohort (N=1,164, 572 events) to test whether the treatment effect is robust to early-mortality bias.
answers.q11: No. That value was computed on the old cohort_v2.csv, not the QC cohort; the user said to treat it as stale. It must be recomputed on cohort_v2_qc.csv before reporting.
answers.q12: The user believes age drives the PH violation, not stage. The evidence is that Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3 while stage is flat. It will be addressed by adding an age × log(time) interaction term to the Cox model.
answers.q13: The bootstrap job (2,000 resamples) is running on lab-ws2 in tmux session 'boot', with results landing in results/boot_ci.csv (~3h runtime). Do NOT restart it.
answers.q14: No. Lifelines must stay at 0.27.8 because v0.28 changed ties handling and would break comparability with round-one numbers.
answers.q15: Parse with dayfirst=True (e.g. pd.read_csv(..., dayfirst=True)) because the CSVs use DD/MM/YYYY format from a UK export; without it, months and days silently swap.
answers.q17: The 17 patients with missing follow-up who were excluded from the QC cohort (cohort_v2_qc.csv); they are administrative censoring cases.
answers.q18: 23 patients died within 90 days (event=1 and time_days ≤ 90). This was verified by running the counting portion of analysis/exclude_early.py in a previous session.
answers.q19: No. The user guesses the treatment effect will remain significant since 23 deaths is only ~2% of the cohort, but the Cox model on the sensitivity cohort has not actually been run yet.
answers.q20: N=1,187 patients, 595 events, 592 censored, 0 missing. These numbers were verified by running the counting portion of analysis/exclude_early.py in a previous session.
answers.q21: Nature Communications revision due 2026-11-14. The editor flagged Reviewer 2's sensitivity analysis request (R2.1, 90-day early-death exclusion) as essential.
answers.q22: Incorporate the bootstrap CIs from boot_ci.csv into Table 2 (update results/table2_draft.csv with QC-cohort HRs and bootstrap CIs), then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis, and write the updated Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph into paper/suggestions.md. The task is done when paper/suggestions.md contains both.
